heroHeadline: Chamber Sends the 2027 Budget to the Senate After a 20-Hour Session, Rejecting Several Ministry Items
heroSubtitle: The Chamber of Deputies dispatched the 2027 Budget Law on November 13, rejecting the Interior, Education, Segegob, Mining, Women and Culture and Science items (Culture failed 59-60). Finance Minister Quiroz says the Senate will restore them with adjustments. The replacement security reform capping a state of exception at 30 days still needs 29 Senate votes.
footerNote: Data sourced from official Chilean government records (Biblioteca del Congreso, Banco Central, SERVEL), Rettig and Valech commissions, IACHR, CIPER Chile, and major international outlets.
